items.title: DTCC Plans Solana Expansion as Wallet Rules Limit Access
items.summary: The US securities clearinghouse plans to bring tokenized stocks to Solana in 2027, but analysts say restrictions could limit adoption.

items.title: Who Is Colette Kress, Jensen Huang’s Successor as Nvidia CEO?
items.summary: Nvidia’s longtime finance chief inherits its first leadership transition in 33 years, bringing decades of technology experience and Wall Street credibility to a company facing a very public leadership test.

items.title: Binance Says Hack Assets Covered, Reserve Proof Pending
items.summary: The exchange says it has closed the remaining gap in customer backing, but users must wait for the new snapshot's cryptographic proof to verify it.

items.title: NYDFS sets fresh advertising standards for crypto firms
items.summary: NYDFS issued guidance outlining expectations for crypto firms to establish policies and procedures governing advertising and marketing.
